description: This file defines the ReadWriteLock class, which implements a synchronization primitive for managing concurrent read and write access. It includes methods for acquiring and releasing read and write locks, and uses internal state management with the StateTrigger class.

classes.name: ReadWriteLock
classes.description: A class providing read-write locking mechanisms with support for multiple readers or a single writer, ensuring thread-safe access to shared resources.

methods.name: ReadLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a read lock, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: ReadUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired read lock.

methods.name: WriteLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a write lock, waiting up to the specified time.

methods.name: WriteUnlock
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired write lock.
